inlines.v: INDIF'FERENTLY, adverb Without distinction or preference; as, to offer pardon indifferently to all. 1. Equally; impartially; without favor, prejudice or bias. --They may truly and indifferently minister justice. 2. In a neutral state; without concern; without wish or aversion. Set honor in one eye and death i'th' other, And I will look on death indifferently 3. Not well; tolerably; passably; as indifferently well; to be indifferently entertained.
